why_a_separate_gate: the D1 smoke verified that a single-opponent pool RESTRICTS selection (only OP9 across 64 episodes). That check is structurally incapable of detecting a sampler that fails to ROTATE, because with |pool| = 1 a broken rotator and a working one are indistinguishable. D3 needs its own gate.

criteria.2_subset: every observed opponent is in the configured pool
criteria.3_coverage: all three opponents are observed at least once in the smoke
criteria.4_no_mixing: no episode contains more than one opponent identity
criteria.5_boundaries: opponent identity is constant within an episode; selection occurs only at episode boundaries
criteria.6_determinism: seed S reproduces the EXACT opponent sequence; a different seed T yields a valid sequence whose entries are all in the pool
criteria.7_no_pathology: counts are consistent with uniform sampling; see the explicit non-requirement below

explicitly_NOT_required.tight_statistical_uniformity: a short smoke must NOT be failed because one opponent appears 18 times and another 25. Uniform sampling is lumpy in small samples, and failing on that would reject a correct sampler.
explicitly_NOT_required.what_replaces_it: criterion 6 -- exact sequence reproducibility under a repeated seed -- is the strong check. Realized per-opponent episode counts are then REPORTED (not gated) from the full 1M D3 runs, where balance is meaningful.

the_determinism_check.procedure: run a short D3 smoke at seed S, record the opponent sequence from episode_rows.csv; repeat at seed S; require the sequences to be identical element-wise. Then run at seed T != S and require every entry to lie in the pool.
the_determinism_check.why_this_is_the_strongest_available: it proves the sampler is a deterministic function of the seed AND rotates, without making a statistical claim a small sample cannot support.

outcome.FAIL: do not launch D3. Repair the sampler seam and re-run the preflight; no D3 training data exists yet, so repair is engineering rather than post-data discretion.

reporting_from_the_full_runs.required: per-opponent episode counts and share for each completed D3 run
reporting_from_the_full_runs.purpose: documents realized exposure so the D1/D3/D7 curve can be read with the actual opponent budget in view

invariants_this_protects.training_budget: fixed at 1,000,000 steps across all rungs
